This source record covers the official Wikidata entity API (wbgetentities at https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php) and the WDQS SPARQL endpoint (https://query.wikidata.org/sparql). Sailboat-class items are instances of Q106179098. Wikipedia article text (CC BY-SA) is explicitly excluded from this access path and must not be ingested via this source record. The Wikimedia User-Agent policy (https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User-Agent_policy) requires a descriptive User-Agent string identifying the project and providing a contact identifier; generic library User-Agents are not acceptable. WDQS SPARQL: recommended max 1 concurrent request per client; observe HTTP 429/Retry-After. wbgetentities: batch up to 50 IDs per request; use format=json.
